subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should #35406 be fixed as a narrow safe `read` fallback, as richer document extraction in core, or deferred to broader document/file-input work?
rationale: The source-reproducible problem is real, but repository policy and current docs split safe fallback, PDF tooling, plugin extraction, and provider-native document forwarding across different ownership boundaries.

options.title: Narrow safe fallback
options.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported/document-tool message instead of raw binary text, without parsing Office archives in core.

options.title: Approve core extraction
options.body: Define the dependency, sandbox, size, ZIP/XML, and test requirements for native DOCX/PPTX/XLSX extraction before merging parser code into core.

options.title: Defer to document-input work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to #12047, #51377, and #91683 while closing or superseding the stale conflicting PR attempts.

recommendation.title: Narrow safe fallback
recommendation.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported/document-tool message instead of raw binary text, without parsing Office archives in core.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent read-wrapper and Office-path history is the best current-main routing signal for choosing the read-tool boundary.
